svg.text: Repeater prototype — wiring diagram (PCB v4.0 in the mine case)
Every cable from the board to the parts in the case, pin by pin · same for the main repeater (IS_GATEWAY 1) and tunnel repeaters (IS_GATEWAY 0)
100 × 75 mm · 4 × M3 on the case standoffs · conformal-coat after test
U1 5 V / 2 A · fuse · TVS · diode OR
stands in for the mine supply
set 12.6 V and 1 A before connecting
IN from the splitter · OUT to the pack
3 × 18650 in series · 11.1 V nom, 12.6 V full
common-port BMS: P+ / P− (charge and load)
B− · B1 · B2 · B+ balance leads to the BMS
inline 3 A blade fuse in P+ recommended
2.4 GHz 3–5 dBi antenna, outside the top wall
leave a service loop to the top
DO (pin 3) is not used — leave it unconnected. MQ module headers are usually VCC GND DO AO;
if yours differs, match by the printed names, not by position.
on the lid, behind the window
on the lid, behind the grille
Cable list (make one set per repeater)
Adapter → M16 gland → Wago → J1 1(+) 2(−) and charge-module IN
BMS P+ / P− → charge-module OUT and J2 1(+) 2(−)
solder + heat-shrink, 3 A fuse in P+
J3 / J4 / J5 → MQ-4 (top) / MQ-7 / MQ-136 (bottom)
3 used: red VCC, black GND, yellow AO
Dupont 4-pin housing on the module header
5: red, black, orange DIN, green CS, blue CLK
4: red, black, blue SDA, green SCL
Dupont 4-pin, pass through the chamber notch
XIAO u.FL → SMA bulkhead (top wall) → antenna
u.FL push-on, do not bend at the plug
1. Set the charge module to 12.6 V / 1 A with nothing connected, then wire it to the pack.
2. XIAO out of its sockets: power J1, check 5.0 V between the 5V and GND socket pins.
3. Fit the XIAO, flash with USB (unplug the matrix + MQ leads while flashing from a laptop port).
4. Plug the leads one at a time; MQ heaters need 24–48 h burn-in before calibration.
Supply and battery feed the board through two diodes; the higher one wins.
With a 12 V adapter the full pack (12.6 V) wins, so the board runs from the pack
while the charger tops it up — works, but set the charger to at least 1 A.
D7 (MAINS_N) is LOW whenever the mine supply is present.
